picks.editorial_note: DOE selected a Fermilab-led team under its new Genesis Mission to build AI systems controlling particle accelerator performance — a flagship federal AI initiative with implications for the entire national lab research infrastructure.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: A £5 million UK government-backed trial of AI-driven flight path adjustments to cut aviation contrails is a rare case of AI research moving directly into real-world climate policy and infrastructure.
picks.title: Operation Blue Skies takes off: landmark trial to test AI-driven contrail avoidance

picks.editorial_note: A University of Houston report projecting up to 32% electricity demand growth by 2030, driven partly by AI, has direct implications for energy policy and infrastructure planning nationwide.
picks.title: University of Houston Report Predicts U.S. Electricity Demand Could Rise 32% by 2030 | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that generative AI outputs from large models often can't be traced to any training example — is a genuine scientific finding with major implications for AI copyright and provenance debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: MIT Lincoln Laboratory's integration of an agentic AI mission-debrief assistant into U.S. Air Force Collaborative Combat Aircraft operations marks a significant step of AI research moving into operational defense systems.
picks.title: Human–AI mission debrief enters the Air Force through ARCADE

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins and Toyota Research Institute are combining AI and high-throughput automated experiments to accelerate discovery of new battery materials, pairing industry resources with academic research at scale.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: A Kent State researcher's DOE Genesis Mission award to mine 50 years of water-quality data for critical mineral deposits shows AI being applied to U.S. supply-chain and resource-security priorities.
picks.title: Kent State Researcher Selected for US Department of Energy Genesis Mission Award to Mine Decades of River Data for Critical Minerals; Kent State Today; July 29, 2026

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's Rosen Center is a partner on over $42 million in NSF grants building national-scale AI and data cyberinfrastructure, underpinning research capacity across many institutions.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: NCSA and UCLA's $9 million NSF-funded iDLab aims to unify browser-based access to national HPC centers, directly supporting the NAIRR initiative's push to democratize AI computing resources.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London and Smith+Nephew's five-year center for surgical robotics translates academic computer-vision research into medical device innovation with a committed industry partner.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics
